module-free DISCOVER emits four14-byte bodies from one coherent32-byte state
version/op/channel/generation/length errors drain complete payloads and preserve framing across token wrap

wire stream survives actual numeric INIT/RUN/error/UNLOAD and deliberate failed native INIT
native OPEN/STATE/WRITE/CLOSE cannot take over a wire owner; native failed RUN cleanup preserves it

missing/multiblock/overflow/end-span refusals, valid zero-frame span and wrong channel/generation preserve stream

native control matches prime/BUSY/drain counters; wire live calls and OPEN cannot inspect, close or steal native stream
native failure/unload still cancel its own producer while explicit native CLOSE leaves module loaded
successful wire CLOSE preserves unrelated loaded module and retained numeric state
selected ordinary DISABLE and global mixer replacement cancel wire owner; original output rate restored
